comments.body:
4 Recipes:

"Experiments on Cannonball Composition and Penetration" Casting 12, Sophia Rank 6, 1980 Sophia
Prototype Armour Howitzer (20) + Set of Dismantling Tools + General Large Hull = Broken Metal Armour Plating

"Ultimate Bow Armour Howitzer" Casting 13, Sophia Rank 6, 2460 Sophia
Deluxe Bow Armour Howitzer + Broken Metal Armour Plating + 5 x Legendary Craftsman's Carpentry Tools = Ultimate Bow Armour Howitzer (same result with normal and great success)

"Ultimate Stern Armour Howitzer" Casting 13, Sophia Rank 6, 2460 Sophia
Deluxe Stern Armour Howitzer + Broken Metal Armour Plating + 5 x Legendary Craftsman's Carpentry Tools = Ultimate Stern Armour Howitzer (same result with normal and great success)

"Ultimate Armour Howitzer (20)" Casting 14, Sophia Rank 6, 2940 Sophia
Deluxe Armour Howitzer (20) + Broken Metal Armour Plating + 10 x Legendary Craftsman's Carpentry Tools = Ultimate Armour Howitzer (20) (same result with normal and great success)
